in_marathi.name: Neelima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neelima is a beautiful Sanskrit name for girls, derived from the term 'Neela' meaning blue and 'Imam' meaning lotus. This name symbolizes the grace and beauty of the blue lotus flower, which blooms in water and represents purity, enlightenment, and detachment. In Hindu mythology, the blue lotus is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
